rate_limits: 30 requests/second on paid usage plans; 429 responses may still occur during bursts. Free-plan request-rate limit is not clearly published.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct; original "not published" is wrong. Official docs: "The current rate limit is 30 requests per second on paid usage plans" and note that 429s can still occur near the limit (https://the-odds-api.com/guide/rate-limit.html). V4 error codes: EXCEEDED_FREQ_LIMIT = 429, "rate limit is currently 30 API calls per second" (https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html). Free-plan RPS not stated separately on those pages.
